252 static int32_t rangeProcHWA_ConfigEDMADummyTwoLinks
253 (
254  EDMA_Handle handle,
255  DPEDMA_3LinkChanCfg *chanCfg,
256  uint8_t chainChId0,
257  uint8_t chainChId1,
258  uint16_t numIter
259 )
260 {
261  EDMACCPaRAMEntry edmaParam;
262  int32_t errorCode = SystemP_SUCCESS;
263  uint16_t linkChId0;
264  uint16_t linkChId1;
265  uint32_t baseAddr, regionId;
266 
267  baseAddr = EDMA_getBaseAddr(handle);
268  if(baseAddr == 0U)
269  {
270  goto exit;
271  }
272 
273  regionId = EDMA_getRegionId(handle);
274  DebugP_assert(regionId < SOC_EDMA_NUM_REGIONS);
275 
276  /* Get LinkChan from configuraiton */
277  linkChId0 = (uint16_t)chanCfg->ShadowPramId[0];
278  linkChId1 = (uint16_t)chanCfg->ShadowPramId[1];
279 
280  /* Program Param Set */
281  EDMA_ccPaRAMEntry_init(&edmaParam);
282  edmaParam.srcAddr = (uint32_t) NULL;
283  edmaParam.destAddr = (uint32_t) NULL;
284  edmaParam.aCnt = (uint16_t) 0u;
285  edmaParam.bCnt = (uint16_t) numIter;
286  edmaParam.cCnt = (uint16_t) 0u;
287  edmaParam.bCntReload = (uint16_t) 0u;
288  edmaParam.srcBIdx = (int16_t) 0u;
289  edmaParam.destBIdx = (int16_t) 0u;
290  edmaParam.srcCIdx = (int16_t) 0u;
291  edmaParam.destCIdx = (int16_t) 0u;
292  edmaParam.linkAddr = 0xFFFFU;
293  edmaParam.opt |= (EDMA_OPT_TCCHEN_MASK | EDMA_OPT_ITCCHEN_MASK |
294  ((((uint32_t)chainChId0) << EDMA_OPT_TCC_SHIFT) & EDMA_OPT_TCC_MASK));
295 
296  EDMA_setPaRAM(baseAddr, chanCfg->paramId, &edmaParam);
297 
298  (void)EDMA_enableTransferRegion(baseAddr, regionId, chanCfg->channel, EDMA_TRIG_MODE_EVENT);
299 
300  CacheP_wbAll(CacheP_TYPE_ALLD);
301 
302  /* Change the parameter set to use different transferCompletionCode */
303  {
304  EDMACCPaRAMEntry paramConfig;
305 
306  EDMA_ccPaRAMEntry_init(&paramConfig);
307  (void)memcpy((void *)&paramConfig, (void *)&edmaParam, sizeof(EDMACCPaRAMEntry));
308 
309  /* to #1 EDMA channel */
310  paramConfig.opt = 0;
311  paramConfig.opt |= (EDMA_OPT_TCCHEN_MASK | EDMA_OPT_ITCCHEN_MASK |
312  ((((uint32_t)chainChId1) << EDMA_OPT_TCC_SHIFT) & EDMA_OPT_TCC_MASK));
313 
314  EDMA_setPaRAM(baseAddr, linkChId1, &paramConfig);
315 
316  /* to #0 EDMA channel */
317  paramConfig.opt = 0u;
318  paramConfig.opt |= (EDMA_OPT_TCCHEN_MASK | EDMA_OPT_ITCCHEN_MASK |
319  ((((uint32_t)chainChId0) << EDMA_OPT_TCC_SHIFT) & EDMA_OPT_TCC_MASK));
320 
321  EDMA_setPaRAM(baseAddr, linkChId0, &paramConfig);
322 
323  /* Link 2 shadow links */
324  /* Do not use LinkChannel API, it changes to ParamId's TCC */
325  HW_WR_FIELD32(baseAddr + EDMA_TPCC_LNK((uint32_t)linkChId0), EDMA_TPCC_LNK_LINK,
326  baseAddr + EDMA_TPCC_OPT((uint32_t)linkChId1));
327 
328  HW_WR_FIELD32(baseAddr + EDMA_TPCC_LNK((uint32_t)linkChId1), EDMA_TPCC_LNK_LINK,
329  baseAddr + EDMA_TPCC_OPT((uint32_t)linkChId0));
330 
331  HW_WR_FIELD32(baseAddr + EDMA_TPCC_LNK((uint32_t)chanCfg->paramId), EDMA_TPCC_LNK_LINK,
332  baseAddr + EDMA_TPCC_OPT((uint32_t)linkChId1));
333  }
334 exit:
335  return(errorCode);
336 }

483 static int32_t rangeProcHWA_ConfigEDMATranspose
484 (
485  rangeProc_dpParams *dpParams,
486  EDMA_Handle handle,
487  DPEDMA_ChanCfg *chanCfg,
488  DPEDMA_ChainingCfg *chainingCfg,
489  uint32_t srcAddress,
490  uint32_t destAddress,
491  bool isTransferCompletionEnabled,
492  Edma_EventCallback transferCompletionCallbackFxn,
493  void* transferCompletionCallbackFxnArg,
494  Edma_IntrObject *intrObj
495 )
496 {
497  DPEDMA_syncABCfg syncABCfg;
498  int32_t retVal;
499 
500  /* dpedma configuration */
501  syncABCfg.aCount = (uint16_t)dpParams->numRxAntennas * (uint16_t)sizeof(cmplx16ImRe_t); //dpParams->sizeOfInputSample; //
502  syncABCfg.bCount = (uint16_t)dpParams->numRangeBins;
503  syncABCfg.cCount = (uint16_t)dpParams->numChirpsPerFrame / 2U;
504  syncABCfg.srcBIdx = (int32_t)dpParams->numRxAntennas * (int32_t)sizeof(cmplx16ImRe_t);
505  syncABCfg.srcCIdx = 0;
506  syncABCfg.dstBIdx = (int32_t)dpParams->numRxAntennas * (int32_t)dpParams->numChirpsPerFrame * (int32_t)sizeof(cmplx16ImRe_t);
507  syncABCfg.dstCIdx = (int16_t)dpParams->numRxAntennas * 2 * (int16_t)sizeof(cmplx16ImRe_t);
508 
509  syncABCfg.srcAddress = srcAddress;
510  syncABCfg.destAddress = destAddress;
511 
512  retVal = DPEDMA_configSyncAB(handle,
513  chanCfg,
514  chainingCfg,
515  &syncABCfg,
516  true, /* isEventTriggered */
517  false, /* isIntermediateTransferCompletionEnabled */
518  isTransferCompletionEnabled, /* isTransferCompletionEnabled */
519  transferCompletionCallbackFxn,
520  transferCompletionCallbackFxnArg,
521  intrObj);
522 
523  if (retVal != SystemP_SUCCESS)
524  {
525  goto exit;
526  }
527 
528 exit:
529  return (retVal);
530 }

546 static int32_t rangeProcHWA_ConfigHWACommon
547 (
548  rangeProcHWAObj *rangeProcObj
549 )
550 {
551  HWA_CommonConfig hwaCommonConfig;
552  rangeProc_dpParams *DPParams;
553  int32_t retVal;
554 
555  DPParams = &rangeProcObj->params;
556 
557  /***********************/
558  /* HWA COMMON CONFIG */
559  /***********************/
560  /* Config Common Registers */
561  hwaCommonConfig.configMask = HWA_COMMONCONFIG_MASK_STATEMACHINE_CFG |/* numLoops, paramStartIdx, paramStopIdx combined here */
562  HWA_COMMONCONFIG_MASK_TWIDDITHERENABLE |
563  HWA_COMMONCONFIG_MASK_LFSRSEED;
564 
565  hwaCommonConfig.fftConfig.twidDitherEnable = HWA_FEATURE_BIT_ENABLE;
566  hwaCommonConfig.fftConfig.lfsrSeed = 0x1234567; /*Some non-zero value*/
567  hwaCommonConfig.numLoops = DPParams->numChirpsPerFrame/2U;
568  hwaCommonConfig.paramStartIdx = rangeProcObj->hwaCfg.paramSetStartIdx;
569  hwaCommonConfig.paramStopIdx = rangeProcObj->hwaCfg.paramSetStartIdx + (uint16_t)rangeProcObj->hwaCfg.numParamSet - 1U;
570 
571  retVal = HWA_configCommon(rangeProcObj->initParms.hwaHandle, &hwaCommonConfig);
572  if (retVal != 0)
573  {
574  goto exit;
575  }
576 
577  /**********************************************/
578  /* ENABLE NUMLOOPS DONE INTERRUPT FROM HWA */
579  /**********************************************/
580  retVal = HWA_enableDoneInterrupt(rangeProcObj->initParms.hwaHandle,
581  0, //thread index
582  rangeProcHWADoneIsrCallback,
583  (void*)&rangeProcObj->hwaDoneSemaHandle);
584  if (retVal != 0)
585  {
586  goto exit;
587  }
588 
589 exit:
590  return(retVal);
591 }
612 static int32_t rangeProcHWA_ConfigHWA
613 (
614  rangeProcHWAObj *rangeProcObj,
615  uint8_t destChanPing,
616  uint8_t destChanPong,
617  uint32_t hwaMemSrcPingOffset,
618  uint32_t hwaMemSrcPongOffset,
619  uint32_t hwaMemDestPingOffset,
620  uint32_t hwaMemDestPongOffset
621 )
622 {
623  HWA_InterruptConfig paramISRConfig;
624  int32_t errCode = 0;
625  uint32_t paramsetIdx = 0;
626  uint32_t hwParamsetIdx;
627  uint32_t pingParamSetIdx = 0;
628  HWA_ParamConfig hwaParamCfg[DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_NUM_HWA_PARAM_SETS];
629  HWA_Handle hwaHandle;
630  rangeProc_dpParams *pDPParams;
631  uint8_t index;
632 
633  hwaHandle = rangeProcObj->initParms.hwaHandle;
634  pDPParams = &rangeProcObj->params;
635 
636  (void)memset(hwaParamCfg,0,sizeof(hwaParamCfg));
637 
638  hwParamsetIdx = rangeProcObj->hwaCfg.paramSetStartIdx;
639  for(index = 0; index < DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_NUM_HWA_PARAM_SETS; index++)
640  {
641  errCode = HWA_disableParamSetInterrupt(hwaHandle, index + rangeProcObj->hwaCfg.paramSetStartIdx,
642  HWA_PARAMDONE_INTERRUPT_TYPE_CPU_INTR1 |HWA_PARAMDONE_INTERRUPT_TYPE_DMA);
643  if (errCode != 0)
644  {
645  goto exit;
646  }
647  }
648 
649  /***********************/
650  /* PING DUMMY PARAMSET */
651  /***********************/
652  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].triggerMode = HWA_TRIG_MODE_DMA;
653  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].triggerSrc = (uint8_t)hwParamsetIdx;
654  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].accelMode = HWA_ACCELMODE_NONE;
655  errCode = HWA_configParamSet(hwaHandle,
656  (uint8_t)hwParamsetIdx,
657  &hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx],NULL);
658  if (errCode != 0)
659  {
660  goto exit;
661  }
662 
663  /***********************/
664  /* PING PROCESS PARAMSET */
665  /***********************/
666  paramsetIdx++;
667  hwParamsetIdx++;
668  pingParamSetIdx = paramsetIdx;
669 
670 
671  if(rangeProcObj->hwaCfg.dataInputMode == DPU_RangeProcHWA_InputMode_HWA_INTERNAL_MEM)
672  {
673  /* At a HWA trigger time adc samples are already in HWA memory */
674  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].triggerMode = HWA_TRIG_MODE_HARDWARE;
675  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].triggerSrc = rangeProcObj->hwaCfg.hardwareTrigSrc;
676  }
677  else
678  {
679  /* adcbuf not mapped, HWA is triggered after edma copy is done */
680  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].triggerMode = HWA_TRIG_MODE_DMA;
681  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].triggerSrc = (uint8_t)hwParamsetIdx;
682  }
683 
684  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].accelMode = HWA_ACCELMODE_FFT;
685  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].source.srcAddr = hwaMemSrcPingOffset;
686 
687  if(pDPParams->isReal != 0U)

696  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].source.srcWidth = HWA_SAMPLES_WIDTH_16BIT;

699  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].source.srcScale = 8;
700 
701  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].dest.dstAddr = hwaMemDestPingOffset;
702 
703  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].dest.dstRealComplex = HWA_SAMPLES_FORMAT_COMPLEX;

709 
710  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].accelModeArgs.fftMode.fftEn = 1;
711  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].accelModeArgs.fftMode.fftSize = mathUtils_ceilLog2(pDPParams->numFFTBins);
712  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].accelModeArgs.fftMode.butterflyScaling =
713  ((uint16_t)1U << pDPParams->numLastButterflyStagesToScale) - 1U;

715  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].accelModeArgs.fftMode.windowStart = rangeProcObj->hwaCfg.hwaWinRamOffset;

718  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].accelModeArgs.fftMode.postProcCfg.magLogEn = HWA_FFT_MODE_MAGNITUDE_LOG2_DISABLED;
719  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].accelModeArgs.fftMode.postProcCfg.fftOutMode = HWA_FFT_MODE_OUTPUT_DEFAULT;
720  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].accelModeArgs.fftMode.preProcCfg.complexMultiply.cmultMode = HWA_COMPLEX_MULTIPLY_MODE_DISABLE;
721 
722  /* HWA range FFT src/dst configuration*/
723  if(rangeProcObj->interleave == DPIF_RXCHAN_INTERLEAVE_MODE)
724  {
725  if(rangeProcObj->radarCubeLayout == rangeProc_dataLayout_RANGE_DOPPLER_TxAnt_RxAnt)
726  {
727  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].source.srcAcnt = pDPParams->numAdcSamples - 1U; /* this is samples - 1 */
728  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].source.srcAIdx = (int32_t)pDPParams->numRxAntennas * (int32_t)pDPParams->sizeOfInputSample;
729  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].source.srcBcnt = (uint16_t)pDPParams->numRxAntennas - 1U;
730  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].source.srcBIdx = (int32_t)pDPParams->sizeOfInputSample;
731 
732  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].dest.dstAcnt = pDPParams->numRangeBins - 1U;
733  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].dest.dstAIdx = (int32_t)pDPParams->numRxAntennas * (int32_t)sizeof(uint32_t);
734  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].dest.dstBIdx = (int32_t)sizeof(uint32_t);
735  }
736  else
737  {
738  /* Other radarCube layout format is not supported */
739  errCode = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_ENOTIMPL;
740  goto exit;
741  }
742  }
743  else
744  {
745  if(rangeProcObj->radarCubeLayout == rangeProc_dataLayout_RANGE_DOPPLER_TxAnt_RxAnt)
746  {
747  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].source.srcAcnt = pDPParams->numAdcSamples - 1U;
748  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].source.srcAIdx = (int32_t)pDPParams->sizeOfInputSample;
749  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].source.srcBcnt = (uint16_t)pDPParams->numRxAntennas - 1U;
750  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].source.srcBIdx = (int32_t)rangeProcObj->rxChanOffset;
751 
752  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].dest.dstAcnt = pDPParams->numRangeBins - 1U;
753  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].dest.dstAIdx = (int32_t)sizeof(uint32_t) * (int32_t)pDPParams->numRxAntennas;
754  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].dest.dstBIdx = (int32_t)sizeof(uint32_t);
755  }
756  else
757  {
758  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].source.srcAcnt = pDPParams->numAdcSamples - 1U;
759  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].source.srcAIdx = (int32_t)pDPParams->sizeOfInputSample;
760  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].source.srcBcnt = (uint16_t)pDPParams->numRxAntennas - 1U;
761  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].source.srcBIdx = (int32_t)rangeProcObj->rxChanOffset;
762  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].dest.dstAcnt = pDPParams->numRangeBins - 1U;
763  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].dest.dstAIdx = (int32_t)sizeof(uint32_t);
764  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].dest.dstBIdx = (int32_t)pDPParams->numRangeBins * (int32_t)sizeof(uint32_t);
765  }
766  }

768  errCode = HWA_configParamSet(hwaHandle,
769  (uint8_t)hwParamsetIdx,
770  &hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx],NULL);
771  if (errCode != 0)
772  {
773  goto exit;
774  }
775 
776  /* enable the DMA hookup to this paramset so that data gets copied out */
777  paramISRConfig.interruptTypeFlag = HWA_PARAMDONE_INTERRUPT_TYPE_DMA;
778  paramISRConfig.dma.dstChannel = destChanPing;
779 
780  errCode = HWA_enableParamSetInterrupt(hwaHandle,(uint8_t)hwParamsetIdx,&paramISRConfig);
781  if (errCode != 0)
782  {
783  goto exit;
784  }
785 
786  /***********************/
787  /* PONG DUMMY PARAMSET */
788  /***********************/
789  paramsetIdx++;
790  hwParamsetIdx++;
791 
792  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].triggerMode = HWA_TRIG_MODE_DMA;
793  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].triggerSrc = (uint8_t)hwParamsetIdx;
794  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].accelMode = HWA_ACCELMODE_NONE;
795  errCode = HWA_configParamSet(hwaHandle,
796  (uint8_t)hwParamsetIdx,
797  &hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx],NULL);
798  if (errCode != 0)
799  {
800  goto exit;
801  }
802 
803  /***********************/
804  /* PONG PROCESS PARAMSET */
805  /***********************/
806  paramsetIdx++;
807  hwParamsetIdx++;
808  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx] = hwaParamCfg[pingParamSetIdx];
809  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].source.srcAddr = hwaMemSrcPongOffset;
810  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].dest.dstAddr = hwaMemDestPongOffset;
811 
812  if(rangeProcObj->hwaCfg.dataInputMode != DPU_RangeProcHWA_InputMode_HWA_INTERNAL_MEM)
813  {
814  hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx].triggerSrc = (uint8_t)hwParamsetIdx;
815  }
816 
817  errCode = HWA_configParamSet(hwaHandle,
818  (uint8_t)hwParamsetIdx,
819  &hwaParamCfg[paramsetIdx],NULL);
820  if (errCode != 0)
821  {
822  goto exit;
823  }
824 
825  /* Enable the DMA hookup to this paramset so that data gets copied out */
826  paramISRConfig.interruptTypeFlag = HWA_PARAMDONE_INTERRUPT_TYPE_DMA;
827  paramISRConfig.dma.dstChannel = destChanPong;
828  errCode = HWA_enableParamSetInterrupt(hwaHandle,
829  (uint8_t)hwParamsetIdx,
830  &paramISRConfig);
831  if (errCode != 0)
832  {
833  goto exit;
834  }
835 exit:
836  return(errCode);
837 }

853 static int32_t rangeProcHWA_TriggerHWA

855  rangeProcHWAObj *rangeProcObj
856 )
857 {
858  int32_t retVal = 0;
859  HWA_Handle hwaHandle;

891 
892 exit:

1110  );

1123  );

1135  for(index = 0; index < 2U; index++)

1183  }
1184 
1185  }

1187 
1188  else if (DPParams->numTxAntennas == 3U)
1189  {
1190

1207  destAddr[0][2] = (uint32_t)(rangeProcObj->radarCubebuf + numSamplePerTx + numSamplePerChirp);
1208  destAddr[1][0] = (uint32_t)(rangeProcObj->radarCubebuf + numSamplePerTx);
1209  destAddr[1][1] = (uint32_t)(rangeProcObj->radarCubebuf + numSamplePerChirp);

1212  /* Desitnation EDMA */
1213  /* Ping configuration to transfer 1D FFT output from HWA to L3 RAM transposed */

1220  );

1226  /* Desitnation EDMA */

1228  errorCode = rangeProcHWA_ConfigEDMADummyThreeLinks(handle,
1229  &pHwConfig->edmaOutCfg.u.fmt2.dataOutPong,

1233  DPParams->numChirpsPerFrame/2U
1234  );

1239 
1240  /* Ping/Pong common configuration */

1246  for(index = 0; index < 3U; index++)

1264  false, /* isEventTriggered */
1265  false, /* isIntermediateTransferInterruptEnabled */
1266  false, /* isTransferCompletionEnabled */
1267  NULL,
1268  NULL,
1269  pHwConfig->intrObj);
1270  if (errorCode != SystemP_SUCCESS)
1271  {
1272  goto exit;
1273  }
1274 
1275  /* PONG specific config
1276  M3 - >Txi (i=1,0, 2) */
1277  syncACfg.srcAddress = hwaOutPongOffset;
1278  syncACfg.destAddress= destAddr[1][index];
1279 
1280  errorCode = DPEDMA_configSyncA_singleFrame(handle,
1281  &pHwConfig->edmaOutCfg.u.fmt2.dataOutPongData[index],
1282  &chainingCfg,
1283  &syncACfg,
1284  false, /* isEventTriggered */
1285  false, /* isIntermediateTransferInterruptEnabled */
1286  lastChan, /* isTransferCompletionEnabled */
1287  (lastChan == true)? rangeProcHWA_EDMA_transferCompletionCallbackFxn : (Edma_EventCallback)NULL,
1288  (lastChan == true)? (void*)rangeProcObj : (void*)NULL,
1289  pHwConfig->intrObj);
1290  if (errorCode != SystemP_SUCCESS)
1291  {
1292  goto exit;
1293  }
1294  }
1295  }
1296  else if(DPParams->numTxAntennas == 2U)
1297  {
1298  /**************************************************************************
1299  * Configure EDMA to copy HWA results to radar cube
1300  * For cases with 2 TX Antenna
1301  *************************************************************************/
1302  /* Ping/Pong common configuration */
1303  syncABCfg.aCount = (uint16_t)DPParams->numRangeBins * (uint16_t)sizeof(uint32_t);
1304  syncABCfg.bCount = DPParams->numRxAntennas;

1307  syncABCfg.srcCIdx = 0;
1308  syncABCfg.dstBIdx = (int32_t)DPParams->numRangeBins * (int32_t)sizeof(uint32_t);
1309  syncABCfg.dstCIdx = (int16_t)DPParams->numRxAntennas * (int16_t)DPParams->numRangeBins * (int16_t)sizeof(uint32_t);

1311  /* Ping specific config */

1314 
1315  errorCode = DPEDMA_configSyncAB(handle,
1316  &pHwConfig->edmaOutCfg.u.fmt1.dataOutPing,
1317  &chainingCfg,
1318  &syncABCfg,
1319  true, /* isEventTriggered */
1320  false, /* isIntermediateTransferCompletionEnabled */
1321  false, /* isTransferCompletionEnabled */
1322  NULL,
1323  NULL,
1324  pHwConfig->intrObj);
1325 
1326  if (errorCode != SystemP_SUCCESS)
1327  {
1328  goto exit;
1329  }
1330 
1331  /* Pong specific configuration */
1332  syncABCfg.srcAddress = hwaOutPongOffset;
1333  syncABCfg.destAddress = (uint32_t)(rangeProcObj->radarCubebuf + numSamplePerTx);
1334 
1335  errorCode = DPEDMA_configSyncAB(handle,
1336  &pHwConfig->edmaOutCfg.u.fmt1.dataOutPong,
1337  &chainingCfg,
1338  &syncABCfg,
1339  true, /* isEventTriggered */
1340  false, /* isIntermediateTransferCompletionEnabled */
1341  true, /*isTransferCompletionEnabled */
1342  rangeProcHWA_EDMA_transferCompletionCallbackFxn,
1343  (void*)rangeProcObj,
1344  pHwConfig->intrObj);
1345  if (errorCode != SystemP_SUCCESS)
1346  {
1347  goto exit;
1348  }
1349  }
1350  else if(DPParams->numTxAntennas == 1U)

1352  uint32_t numSamplePerChirp;

1354  numSamplePerChirp = (uint32_t)DPParams->numRangeBins * (uint32_t)DPParams->numRxAntennas;
1355 
1356  /**************************************************************************
1357  * Configure EDMA to copy HWA results to radar cube
1358  * For cases with 1 TX Antenna
1359  *************************************************************************/

1361 
1362  /* Ping/Pong common configuration */
1363  syncACfg.aCount = (uint16_t)numSamplePerChirp * (uint16_t)sizeof(cmplx16ImRe_t);

1368  /* Ping specific config */

1370  syncACfg.destAddress= (uint32_t)rangeProcObj->radarCubebuf;
1371 
1372  errorCode = DPEDMA_configSyncA_singleFrame(handle,
1373  &pHwConfig->edmaOutCfg.u.fmt1.dataOutPing,
1374  &chainingCfg,
1375  &syncACfg,
1376  true, /*isEventTriggered */
1377  false, /*isIntermediateTransferCompletionEnabled */
1378  false, /*isTransferCompletionEnabled */
1379  NULL,
1380  NULL,
1381  pHwConfig->intrObj);

1384  {
1385  goto exit;

1387 
1388  /* Pong specific configuration */

1392  errorCode = DPEDMA_configSyncA_singleFrame(handle,
1393  &pHwConfig->edmaOutCfg.u.fmt1.dataOutPong,
1394  &chainingCfg,
1395  &syncACfg,
1396  true, /*isEventTriggered */
1397  false, /* isIntermediateTransferCompletionEnabled */
1398  true, /*isTransferCompletionEnabled */
1399  rangeProcHWA_EDMA_transferCompletionCallbackFxn,
1400  (void *)rangeProcObj,

1413  /**************************************************************************

1416  errorCode = DPEDMAHWA_configTwoHotSignature(handle,

1448 static int32_t rangeProcHWA_ConfigEDMA_DataIn
1449 (
1450  rangeProcHWAObj *rangeProcObj,
1451  rangeProc_dpParams *DPParams,
1452  DPU_RangeProcHWA_HW_Resources *pHwConfig
1453 )
1454 {
1455  int32_t errorCode = SystemP_SUCCESS;
1456  EDMA_Handle handle ;
1457  uint16_t bytePerRxChan;
1458  DPEDMA_ChainingCfg chainingCfg;
1459  uint32_t temp;
1460 
1461  /* Get rangeProc Configuration */
1462  handle = rangeProcObj->edmaHandle;
1463 
1464  bytePerRxChan = DPParams->numAdcSamples * DPParams->sizeOfInputSample;
1465 
1466  /**********************************************/
1467  /* ADCBuf -> Ping/Pong Buffer(M0 and M1) */
1468  /**********************************************/
1469  chainingCfg.chainingChannel = (uint8_t)pHwConfig->edmaInCfg.dataInSignature.channel;
1470  chainingCfg.isFinalChainingEnabled = true;
1471  chainingCfg.isIntermediateChainingEnabled = true;
1472 
1473  if (rangeProcObj->interleave == DPIF_RXCHAN_NON_INTERLEAVE_MODE)
1474  {
1475  DPEDMA_syncABCfg syncABCfg;
1476 
1477  syncABCfg.srcAddress = (uint32_t)rangeProcObj->ADCdataBuf;
1478  syncABCfg.destAddress = rangeProcObj->hwaMemBankAddr[DPU_RANGEHWA_MEM_BANK_INDX_SRC_PING];
1479 
1480  syncABCfg.aCount = bytePerRxChan;
1481  syncABCfg.bCount = DPParams->numRxAntennas;
1482  syncABCfg.cCount =2U; /* ping and pong */
1483 
1484  syncABCfg.srcBIdx = (int32_t)rangeProcObj->rxChanOffset;
1485  syncABCfg.dstBIdx = (int32_t)rangeProcObj->rxChanOffset;
1486  syncABCfg.srcCIdx = 0;
1487  temp = (uint32_t)rangeProcObj->hwaMemBankAddr[DPU_RANGEHWA_MEM_BANK_INDX_SRC_PONG] - (uint32_t)rangeProcObj->hwaMemBankAddr[DPU_RANGEHWA_MEM_BANK_INDX_SRC_PING];
1488  syncABCfg.dstCIdx = (int16_t)(temp);
1489 
1490  errorCode = DPEDMA_configSyncAB(handle,
1491  &pHwConfig->edmaInCfg.dataIn,
1492  &chainingCfg,
1493  &syncABCfg,
1494  true, /* isEventTriggered */
1495  /* Intermediate and Final transfer interrupts are enabled in case
1496  * the user wants to poll the IPR(H) register (for example,
1497  * in the range proc test case) or register an ISR for when a chirp
1498  * transfer from to HWA memory is complete */
1499  true, /* isIntermediateTransferCompletionEnabled */
1500  true, /* isTransferCompletionEnabled */
1501  NULL,
1502  NULL,
1503  pHwConfig->intrObj);
1504  }
1505  else
1506  {
1507  DPEDMA_syncACfg syncACfg;
1508 
1509  syncACfg.srcAddress = (uint32_t)rangeProcObj->ADCdataBuf;
1510  syncACfg.destAddress = rangeProcObj->hwaMemBankAddr[DPU_RANGEHWA_MEM_BANK_INDX_SRC_PING];
1511  syncACfg.aCount = bytePerRxChan * DPParams->numRxAntennas;
1512  syncACfg.bCount = 2U; /* ping and pong */
1513  syncACfg.srcBIdx = 0;
1514  syncACfg.dstBIdx = ((int32_t)rangeProcObj->hwaMemBankAddr[DPU_RANGEHWA_MEM_BANK_INDX_SRC_PONG] - (int32_t)rangeProcObj->hwaMemBankAddr[DPU_RANGEHWA_MEM_BANK_INDX_SRC_PING]);
1515 
1516  errorCode = DPEDMA_configSyncA_singleFrame(handle,
1517  &pHwConfig->edmaInCfg.dataIn,
1518  &chainingCfg,
1519  &syncACfg,
1520  /* Intermediate and Final transfer interrupts are enabled in case
1521  * the user wants to poll the IPR(H) register (for example,
1522  * in the range proc test case) or register an ISR for when a chirp
1523  * transfer from to HWA memory is complete */
1524  true, /* isEventTriggered */
1525  true, /* isIntermediateTransferCompletionEnabled */
1526  true, /* isTransferCompletionEnabled */
1527  NULL,
1528  NULL,
1529  pHwConfig->intrObj);
1530  }
1531 
1532  if (errorCode != SystemP_SUCCESS)
1533  {
1534  goto exit;
1535  }
1536 
1537  /*************************************************/
1538  /* Generate Hot Signature to trigger Ping/Pong paramset */
1539  /*************************************************/
1540 
1541  errorCode = DPEDMAHWA_configTwoHotSignature(handle,
1542  &pHwConfig->edmaInCfg.dataInSignature,
1543  rangeProcObj->initParms.hwaHandle,
1544  rangeProcObj->dataInTrigger[0],
1545  rangeProcObj->dataInTrigger[1],
1546  false);
1547 
1548  if (errorCode != SystemP_SUCCESS)
1549  {
1550  goto exit;
1551  }
1552 exit:
1553  return(errorCode);
1554 }

1572 static int32_t rangeProcHWA_ConfigInterleaveMode

1600  if(pHwConfig->hwaCfg.dataInputMode == DPU_RangeProcHWA_InputMode_ISOLATED)

1617  );

1626  DPU_RANGEHWA_SRCADDR_PING,
1627  DPU_RANGEHWA_DSTADDR_PING,
1628  DPU_RANGEHWA_DSTADDR_PONG
1629  );
1630  }
1631  else if (pHwConfig->hwaCfg.dataInputMode == DPU_RangeProcHWA_InputMode_HWA_INTERNAL_MEM)

1650  }

1680 static int32_t rangeProcHWA_ConfigNonInterleaveMode
1681 (
1682  rangeProcHWAObj *rangeProcObj,
1683  rangeProc_dpParams *DPParams,
1684  DPU_RangeProcHWA_HW_Resources *pHwConfig
1685 )
1686 {
1687  HWA_Handle hwaHandle;
1688  int32_t retVal = 0;
1689  uint8_t destChanPing;
1690  uint8_t destChanPong;
1691  uint8_t edmaChanPing;
1692  uint8_t edmaChanPong;
1693 
1694  hwaHandle = rangeProcObj->initParms.hwaHandle;
1695 
1696 
1697  if((rangeProcObj->radarCubeLayout == rangeProc_dataLayout_TxAnt_DOPPLER_RxAnt_RANGE) &&
1698  (DPParams->numTxAntennas == 3U || DPParams->numTxAntennas == 4U) )
1699  {
1700  edmaChanPing = (uint8_t)pHwConfig->edmaOutCfg.u.fmt2.dataOutPing.channel;
1701  edmaChanPong = (uint8_t)pHwConfig->edmaOutCfg.u.fmt2.dataOutPong.channel;
1702  }
1703  else
1704  {
1705  edmaChanPing = (uint8_t)pHwConfig->edmaOutCfg.u.fmt1.dataOutPing.channel;
1706  edmaChanPong = (uint8_t)pHwConfig->edmaOutCfg.u.fmt1.dataOutPong.channel;
1707  }
1708 
1709  /* Get HWA destination channel id */
1710  retVal = HWA_getDMAChanIndex(hwaHandle, (uint8_t)edmaChanPing, &destChanPing);
1711  if (retVal != 0)
1712  {
1713  goto exit;
1714  }
1715  /* In interleave mode, only edmaOutCfgFmt is supported */
1716  retVal = HWA_getDMAChanIndex(hwaHandle, (uint8_t)edmaChanPong, &destChanPong);
1717  if (retVal != 0)
1718  {
1719  goto exit;
1720  }
1721 
1722  /* In ADCBuf and HWA memory isolated mode,
1723  - copy data from ADCBuf to HWA memory by EDMA
1724  - trigger HWA */
1725  if(pHwConfig->hwaCfg.dataInputMode == DPU_RangeProcHWA_InputMode_ISOLATED)
1726  {
1727  /* Copy data from ADC buffer to HWA buffer */
1728  retVal = rangeProcHWA_ConfigEDMA_DataIn(rangeProcObj, DPParams, pHwConfig);
1729  if (retVal != 0)
1730  {
1731  goto exit;
1732  }
1733 
1734  /* Range FFT configuration in HWA */
1735  retVal = rangeProcHWA_ConfigHWA(rangeProcObj,
1736  destChanPing,
1737  destChanPong,
1738  DPU_RANGEHWA_SRCADDR_PING,
1739  DPU_RANGEHWA_SRCADDR_PONG,
1740  DPU_RANGEHWA_DSTADDR_PING,
1741  DPU_RANGEHWA_DSTADDR_PONG
1742  );
1743  }
1744  else if(pHwConfig->hwaCfg.dataInputMode == DPU_RangeProcHWA_InputMode_MAPPED)
1745  {
1746  /* EDMA copy is not needed */
1747 
1748  /* Range FFT configuration in HWA */
1749  retVal = rangeProcHWA_ConfigHWA(rangeProcObj,
1750  destChanPing,
1751  destChanPong,
1752  DPU_RANGEHWA_SRCADDR_PING,
1753  DPU_RANGEHWA_SRCADDR_PING,
1754  DPU_RANGEHWA_DSTADDR_PING,
1755  DPU_RANGEHWA_DSTADDR_PONG
1756  );
1757  }
1758  else if(pHwConfig->hwaCfg.dataInputMode == DPU_RangeProcHWA_InputMode_HWA_INTERNAL_MEM)
1759  {
1760  /* EDMA copy is not needed */
1761 
1762  /* Range FFT configuration in HWA */
1763  retVal = rangeProcHWA_ConfigHWA(rangeProcObj,
1764  destChanPing,
1765  destChanPong,
1766  DPU_RANGEHWA_SRCADDR_PING,
1767  DPU_RANGEHWA_SRCADDR_PONG,
1768  DPU_RANGEHWA_DSTADDR_PING,
1769  DPU_RANGEHWA_DSTADDR_PONG
1770  );
1771  }
1772  else
1773  {
1774  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_EINVAL;
1775  }
1776  if(retVal < 0)
1777  {
1778  goto exit;
1779  }
1780 
1781  /* Data output EDMA configuration */
1782  retVal = rangeProcHWA_ConfigEDMA_DataOut_nonInterleave(rangeProcObj,
1783  DPParams,
1784  pHwConfig,
1785  (uint32_t)rangeProcObj->hwaMemBankAddr[DPU_RANGEHWA_MEM_BANK_INDX_DST_PING],
1786  (uint32_t)rangeProcObj->hwaMemBankAddr[DPU_RANGEHWA_MEM_BANK_INDX_DST_PONG]);
1787  if (retVal < 0)
1788  {
1789  goto exit;
1790  }
1791 
1792 exit:
1793  return (retVal);
1794 }

1812 static int32_t rangeProcHWA_dcRangeSignatureCompensation_init
1813 (
1814  rangeProcHWAObj *rangeProcObj,
1815  DPU_RangeProc_CalibDcRangeSigCfg *calibDcRangeSigCfg,
1816  uint8_t resetMeanBuffer
1817 )
1818 {

1822  meanbufSize = DPU_RANGEPROC_SIGNATURE_COMP_MAX_BIN_SIZE * (uint32_t)rangeProcObj->params.numVirtualAntennas
1823  * (uint32_t)sizeof(cmplx32ImRe_t);

1825  /* Validate DC removal configuration */
1826  if(calibDcRangeSigCfg->enabled != 0U)
1827  {
1828 #if defined(DEBUG_CHECK_PARAMS) && DEBUG_CHECK_PARAMS
1829  if(rangeProcObj->dcRangeSigMean == (cmplx32ImRe_t*)NULL)
1830  {
1831  /* Check DC range average buffer pointer */

1833  goto exit;

1835 
1836  if(
1837 #ifdef SUBSYS_MSS
1838  CSL_MEM_IS_NOT_ALIGN(rangeProcObj->dcRangeSigMean,
1839  DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_DCRANGESIGMEAN_BYTE_ALIGNMENT_R5F))
1840 #else
1841  CSL_MEM_IS_NOT_ALIGN(rangeProcObj->dcRangeSigMean,
1842  DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_DCRANGESIGMEAN_BYTE_ALIGNMENT_DSP))
1843 
1844 #endif
1845  {
1846  /* Check DC range average buffer pointer alignment */
1847  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_EDCREMOVAL;
1848  goto exit;
1849  }
1850 
1851  if(meanbufSize > rangeProcObj->dcRangeSigMeanSize)
1852  {
1853  /* Check DC range average buffer size */
1854  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_EDCREMOVAL;
1855  goto exit;
1856  }
1857 #endif
1858 
1859  /* Initialize memory */
1860  if (resetMeanBuffer == 1U)
1861  {
1862  (void)memset((void *)rangeProcObj->dcRangeSigMean, 0, meanbufSize);
1863  rangeProcObj->dcRangeSigCalibCntr = 0;
1864  }
1865  rangeProcObj->calibDcNumLog2AvgChirps = mathUtils_floorLog2(calibDcRangeSigCfg->numAvgChirps);
1866  }
1867  else
1868  {
1869  /* Feature is disabled , nothing needs to done here */
1870  }
1871 
1872 exit:
1873  return (retVal);
1874 }

1888 static void rangeProcHWA_dcRangeSignatureCompensation
1889 (
1890  rangeProcHWAObj *obj
1891 )
1892 {
1893  uint32_t antIdx;
1894  int32_t rngBinIdx;
1895  uint32_t ind;
1896  uint32_t dcRangeSigMeanSize;
1897  uint32_t doppIdx;
1898  cmplx16ImRe_t *fftOut1D;
1899  DPU_RangeProc_CalibDcRangeSigCfg *calibDc = &obj->calibDcRangeSigCfg;
1900  int32_t negativeBinIdx = calibDc->negativeBinIdx;
1901  int32_t positiveBinIdx = calibDc->positiveBinIdx;
1902  cmplx32ImRe_t *dcRangeSigMean = obj->dcRangeSigMean;
1903  rangeProc_dpParams *dpParams;
1904 
1905  dpParams = &obj->params;
1906  fftOut1D = (cmplx16ImRe_t *) obj->radarCubebuf;
1907 
1908  dcRangeSigMeanSize = (uint32_t)dpParams->numVirtualAntennas * (uint32_t)(positiveBinIdx - negativeBinIdx + 1);
1909  if (obj->dcRangeSigCalibCntr == 0U)
1910  {
1911  (void)memset(dcRangeSigMean, 0, (uint32_t)dcRangeSigMeanSize * sizeof(cmplx32ImRe_t));
1912  }
1913 
1914  /* RadarCube FMT2 */
1915  if(obj->radarCubeLayout == rangeProc_dataLayout_RANGE_DOPPLER_TxAnt_RxAnt)
1916  {
1917  uint32_t rngOffset;
1918  uint32_t numVirtAnt;
1919 
1920  numVirtAnt = (uint32_t)dpParams->numVirtualAntennas;
1921 
1922  rngOffset = (uint32_t)dpParams->numVirtualAntennas * (uint32_t)dpParams->numDopplerChirps;
1923  /* Calibration */
1924  if (obj->dcRangeSigCalibCntr < calibDc->numAvgChirps)
1925  {
1926 #ifdef SUBSYS_MSS
1927  /* radarCube in L3, need to invalidate the cache before use the data */
1928  CacheP_inv(fftOut1D, sizeof(cmplx16ImRe_t) * ((uint32_t)positiveBinIdx+1U) * rngOffset, CacheP_TYPE_ALLD);
1929  CacheP_inv(&fftOut1D[((int32_t)dpParams->numRangeBins + negativeBinIdx) * (int32_t)rngOffset],
1930  (uint32_t)sizeof(cmplx16ImRe_t) * (uint32_t)(-negativeBinIdx) * rngOffset, CacheP_TYPE_ALLD);
1931 #endif
1932  for (doppIdx = 0; doppIdx < dpParams->numDopplerChirps; doppIdx++)
1933  {
1934  /* Accumulate */
1935  ind = 0;
1936  for (rngBinIdx = 0; rngBinIdx <= positiveBinIdx; rngBinIdx++)
1937  {
1938  for (antIdx = 0; antIdx < numVirtAnt; antIdx++)
1939  {
1940  uint32_t binIdx = (uint32_t)rngBinIdx * rngOffset + doppIdx * numVirtAnt + antIdx;
1941  dcRangeSigMean[ind].real += fftOut1D[binIdx].real;
1942  dcRangeSigMean[ind].imag += fftOut1D[binIdx].imag;
1943  ind++;
1944  }
1945  }
1946  for (rngBinIdx = 0; rngBinIdx < -negativeBinIdx; rngBinIdx++)
1947  {
1948  for (antIdx = 0; antIdx < numVirtAnt; antIdx++)
1949  {
1950  uint32_t binIdx = (uint32_t)((int32_t)dpParams->numRangeBins + negativeBinIdx + rngBinIdx) * rngOffset +
1951  doppIdx * numVirtAnt + antIdx;
1952  dcRangeSigMean[ind].real += fftOut1D[binIdx].real;
1953  dcRangeSigMean[ind].imag += fftOut1D[binIdx].imag;
1954  ind++;
1955  }
1956  }
1957  obj->dcRangeSigCalibCntr++;
1958  }
1959 
1960  if (obj->dcRangeSigCalibCntr == calibDc->numAvgChirps)
1961  {
1962  /* Average */
1963  for (ind = 0; ind < dcRangeSigMeanSize; ind++)
1964  {
1965  dcRangeSigMean[ind].real = dcRangeSigMean[ind].real >> obj->calibDcNumLog2AvgChirps;
1966  dcRangeSigMean[ind].imag = dcRangeSigMean[ind].imag >> obj->calibDcNumLog2AvgChirps;
1967  }
1968  }
1969  }
1970  else /*after numAvgChirps, do compensation*/
1971  {
1972  /* fftOut1D -= dcRangeSigMean */
1973  for (doppIdx = 0; doppIdx < dpParams->numDopplerChirps; doppIdx++)
1974  {
1975  ind = 0;
1976  for (rngBinIdx = 0; rngBinIdx <= positiveBinIdx; rngBinIdx++)
1977  {
1978  for (antIdx = 0; antIdx < numVirtAnt; antIdx++)
1979  {
1980  uint32_t binIdx = (uint32_t)rngBinIdx * rngOffset + doppIdx * numVirtAnt + antIdx;
1981 
1982  fftOut1D[binIdx].real -= (int16_t)dcRangeSigMean[ind].real;
1983  fftOut1D[binIdx].imag -= (int16_t)dcRangeSigMean[ind].imag;
1984  ind++;
1985  }
1986  }
1987  for (rngBinIdx = 0; rngBinIdx < -negativeBinIdx; rngBinIdx++)
1988  {
1989  for (antIdx = 0; antIdx < numVirtAnt; antIdx++)
1990  {
1991  uint32_t binIdx = (uint32_t)((int32_t)dpParams->numRangeBins + negativeBinIdx + rngBinIdx) * rngOffset +
1992  doppIdx * numVirtAnt + antIdx;
1993  fftOut1D[binIdx].real -= (int16_t)dcRangeSigMean[ind].real;
1994  fftOut1D[binIdx].imag -= (int16_t)dcRangeSigMean[ind].imag;
1995  ind++;
1996  }
1997  }
1998  }
1999 #ifdef SUBSYS_MSS
2000  /* radarCube in L3, need to do cache write back after modify the data */
2001  CacheP_wb(fftOut1D, sizeof(cmplx16ImRe_t) * ((uint32_t)positiveBinIdx+1U) * rngOffset, CacheP_TYPE_ALLD);
2002  CacheP_wb(&fftOut1D[(uint32_t)((int32_t)dpParams->numRangeBins + negativeBinIdx) * rngOffset],
2003  (uint32_t)sizeof(cmplx16ImRe_t) * (uint32_t)(-negativeBinIdx) * rngOffset, CacheP_TYPE_ALLD);
2004 #endif
2005  }
2006  }
2007  else
2008  {
2009  /* RadarCube FMT1 */
2010  uint32_t txAntIdx;
2011  uint32_t rxAntIdx;
2012  uint32_t txAntOffset;
2013  uint32_t dopOffset;
2014 
2015  /* FMT1: cmplx16ImRe_t x[numTXPatterns][numDopplerChirps][numRX][numRangeBins] |1D Range FFT output*/
2016  txAntOffset = (uint32_t)dpParams->numRxAntennas * (uint32_t)dpParams->numDopplerChirps * (uint32_t)dpParams->numRangeBins;
2017  dopOffset = (uint32_t)dpParams->numRxAntennas * (uint32_t)dpParams->numRangeBins;
2018 
2019  /* Calibration */
2020  if (obj->dcRangeSigCalibCntr < calibDc->numAvgChirps)
2021  {
2022 #ifdef SUBSYS_MSS
2023  /* radarCube in L3, need to invalidate the cache before use the data */
2024  for (txAntIdx = 0; txAntIdx< dpParams->numTxAntennas; txAntIdx++)
2025  {
2026  for (doppIdx = 0; doppIdx < dpParams->numDopplerChirps; doppIdx++)
2027  {
2028  for (rxAntIdx = 0; rxAntIdx < dpParams->numRxAntennas; rxAntIdx++)
2029  {
2030  CacheP_inv(&fftOut1D[txAntIdx*txAntOffset + doppIdx*dopOffset + rxAntIdx*dpParams->numRangeBins],
2031  (uint32_t)sizeof(cmplx16ImRe_t) * ((uint32_t)positiveBinIdx+1U), CacheP_TYPE_ALLD);
2032  CacheP_inv(&fftOut1D[txAntIdx*txAntOffset + doppIdx*dopOffset + rxAntIdx*dpParams->numRangeBins
2033  + (uint32_t)((int32_t)dpParams->numRangeBins + negativeBinIdx)],
2034  (uint32_t)sizeof(cmplx16ImRe_t) * (uint32_t)(-negativeBinIdx), CacheP_TYPE_ALLD);
2035  }
2036  }
2037  }
2038 #endif
2039  for (doppIdx = 0; doppIdx < dpParams->numDopplerChirps; doppIdx++)
2040  {
2041  /* Accumulate for all doppler bins */
2042  ind = 0;
2043 
2044  for(txAntIdx = 0; txAntIdx< dpParams->numTxAntennas; txAntIdx++)
2045  {
2046  for (rngBinIdx = 0; rngBinIdx <= positiveBinIdx; rngBinIdx++)
2047  {
2048  for (rxAntIdx = 0; rxAntIdx < dpParams->numRxAntennas; rxAntIdx++)
2049  {
2050  uint32_t binIdx = txAntIdx * txAntOffset + doppIdx * dopOffset +
2051  dpParams->numRangeBins * rxAntIdx +
2052  (uint32_t)rngBinIdx;
2053  dcRangeSigMean[ind].real += fftOut1D[binIdx].real;
2054  dcRangeSigMean[ind].imag += fftOut1D[binIdx].imag;
2055  ind++;
2056  }
2057  }
2058  for (rngBinIdx = 0; rngBinIdx < -negativeBinIdx; rngBinIdx++)
2059  {
2060  for (rxAntIdx = 0; rxAntIdx < dpParams->numRxAntennas; rxAntIdx++)
2061  {
2062  uint32_t binIdx = txAntIdx * txAntOffset + doppIdx * dopOffset +
2063  dpParams->numRangeBins * rxAntIdx +
2064  (uint32_t)((int32_t)dpParams->numRangeBins + negativeBinIdx + rngBinIdx);
2065 
2066  dcRangeSigMean[ind].real += fftOut1D[binIdx].real;
2067  dcRangeSigMean[ind].imag += fftOut1D[binIdx].imag;
2068  ind++;
2069  }
2070  }
2071  }
2072  obj->dcRangeSigCalibCntr++;
2073  }
2074 
2075  if (obj->dcRangeSigCalibCntr == calibDc->numAvgChirps)
2076  {
2077  /* Average */
2078  for (ind = 0; ind < dcRangeSigMeanSize; ind++)
2079  {
2080  dcRangeSigMean[ind].real = dcRangeSigMean[ind].real >> obj->calibDcNumLog2AvgChirps;
2081  dcRangeSigMean[ind].imag = dcRangeSigMean[ind].imag >> obj->calibDcNumLog2AvgChirps;
2082  }
2083  }
2084  }
2085  else /*after numAvgChirps, do compensation*/
2086  {
2087  /* fftOut1D -= dcRangeSigMean */
2088  for (doppIdx = 0; doppIdx < dpParams->numDopplerChirps; doppIdx++)
2089  {
2090  ind = 0;
2091  for(txAntIdx = 0; txAntIdx< dpParams->numTxAntennas; txAntIdx++)
2092  {
2093  for (rngBinIdx = 0; rngBinIdx <= positiveBinIdx; rngBinIdx++)
2094  {
2095  for (rxAntIdx = 0; rxAntIdx < dpParams->numRxAntennas; rxAntIdx++)
2096  {
2097  uint32_t binIdx = txAntIdx * txAntOffset + doppIdx * dopOffset +
2098  dpParams->numRangeBins * rxAntIdx +
2099  (uint32_t)rngBinIdx;
2100  fftOut1D[binIdx].real -= (int16_t)dcRangeSigMean[ind].real;
2101  fftOut1D[binIdx].imag -= (int16_t)dcRangeSigMean[ind].imag;
2102  ind++;
2103  }
2104  }
2105  for (rngBinIdx = 0; rngBinIdx < -negativeBinIdx; rngBinIdx++)
2106  {
2107  for (rxAntIdx = 0; rxAntIdx < dpParams->numRxAntennas; rxAntIdx++)
2108  {
2109  uint32_t binIdx = txAntIdx * txAntOffset + doppIdx * dopOffset +
2110  dpParams->numRangeBins * rxAntIdx +
2111  (uint32_t)((int32_t)dpParams->numRangeBins + negativeBinIdx + rngBinIdx);
2112  fftOut1D[binIdx].real -= (int16_t)dcRangeSigMean[ind].real;
2113  fftOut1D[binIdx].imag -= (int16_t)dcRangeSigMean[ind].imag;
2114  ind++;
2115  }
2116  }
2117  }
2118  }
2119 #ifdef SUBSYS_MSS
2120  /* radarCube in L3, need to do cache write back after modify the data */
2121  for (txAntIdx = 0; txAntIdx< dpParams->numTxAntennas; txAntIdx++)
2122  {
2123  for (doppIdx = 0; doppIdx < dpParams->numDopplerChirps; doppIdx++)
2124  {
2125  for (rxAntIdx = 0; rxAntIdx < dpParams->numRxAntennas; rxAntIdx++)
2126  {
2127  CacheP_wb(&fftOut1D[txAntIdx*txAntOffset + doppIdx*dopOffset + rxAntIdx*dpParams->numRangeBins],
2128  (uint32_t)sizeof(cmplx16ImRe_t) * ((uint32_t)positiveBinIdx+1U), CacheP_TYPE_ALLD);
2129  CacheP_wb(&fftOut1D[txAntIdx*txAntOffset + doppIdx*dopOffset + rxAntIdx*dpParams->numRangeBins
2130  + (uint32_t)((int32_t)dpParams->numRangeBins + negativeBinIdx)],
2131  (uint32_t)sizeof(cmplx16ImRe_t) * (uint32_t)(-negativeBinIdx), CacheP_TYPE_ALLD);
2132  }
2133  }
2134  }
2135 #endif
2136  }
2137  }
2138 }
2154 static int32_t rangeProcHWA_ParseConfig
2155 (
2156  rangeProcHWAObj *rangeProcObj,
2157  DPU_RangeProcHWA_Config *pConfigIn
2158 )
2159 {
2160  int32_t retVal = 0;
2161  rangeProc_dpParams *params;
2162  DPU_RangeProcHWA_StaticConfig *pStaticCfg;
2163 
2164  /* Get configuration pointers */
2165  pStaticCfg = &pConfigIn->staticCfg;
2166  params = &rangeProcObj->params;
2167 
2168  /* Save datapath parameters */
2169  params->numTxAntennas = pStaticCfg->numTxAntennas;
2170  params->numRxAntennas = pStaticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.numRxAntennas;
2171  params->numVirtualAntennas = pStaticCfg->numVirtualAntennas;
2172  params->numChirpsPerChirpEvent = pStaticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.numChirpsPerChirpEvent;
2173  params->numAdcSamples = pStaticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.numAdcSamples;
2174  params->numRangeBins = pStaticCfg->numRangeBins;
2175  params->numFFTBins = pStaticCfg->numFFTBins;
2176 
2177  if(pStaticCfg->isChirpDataReal != 0U)
2178  {
2179  params->isReal = 1;
2180  params->sizeOfInputSample = (uint16_t)sizeof(int16_t);
2181  }
2182  else
2183  {
2184  params->isReal = 0;
2185  params->sizeOfInputSample = (uint16_t)sizeof(cmplx16ImRe_t);
2186  }
2187  params->numChirpsPerFrame = pStaticCfg->numChirpsPerFrame;
2188  params->numDopplerChirps = pStaticCfg->numChirpsPerFrame/pStaticCfg->numTxAntennas;
2189  params->fftOutputDivShift = pStaticCfg->rangeFFTtuning.fftOutputDivShift;
2190  params->numLastButterflyStagesToScale = pStaticCfg->rangeFFTtuning.numLastButterflyStagesToScale;
2191 
2192  /* Save buffers */
2193  rangeProcObj->ADCdataBuf = (cmplx16ImRe_t *)pStaticCfg->ADCBufData.data;
2194  rangeProcObj->radarCubebuf = (cmplx16ImRe_t *)pConfigIn->hwRes.radarCube.data;
2195 
2196  /* Save interleave mode from ADCBuf configuraiton */
2197  rangeProcObj->interleave = pStaticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.interleave;
2198 
2199  if((rangeProcObj->interleave == DPIF_RXCHAN_NON_INTERLEAVE_MODE) &&
2200  (rangeProcObj->params.numRxAntennas > 1U) )
2201  {
2202  /* For rangeProcDPU needs rx channel has same offset from one channel to the next channel
2203  Use first two channel offset to calculate the BIdx for EDMA
2204  */
2205  rangeProcObj->rxChanOffset = pStaticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.rxChanOffset[1] -
2206  pStaticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.rxChanOffset[0];
2207 
2208  /* rxChanOffset should be 16 bytes aligned and should be big enough to hold numAdcSamples */
2209  if ((rangeProcObj->rxChanOffset < (rangeProcObj->params.numAdcSamples * rangeProcObj->params.sizeOfInputSample)) ||
2210  ((rangeProcObj->rxChanOffset & 0xFU) != 0U))
2211  {
2212  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_EADCBUF_INTF;
2213  goto exit;
2214  }
2215  }
2216 
2217  /* Save RadarCube format */
2218  if (pConfigIn->hwRes.radarCube.datafmt == DPIF_RADARCUBE_FORMAT_2)
2219  {
2220  rangeProcObj->radarCubeLayout = rangeProc_dataLayout_RANGE_DOPPLER_TxAnt_RxAnt;
2221  }
2222  else if(pConfigIn->hwRes.radarCube.datafmt == DPIF_RADARCUBE_FORMAT_1)
2223  {
2224  rangeProcObj->radarCubeLayout = rangeProc_dataLayout_TxAnt_DOPPLER_RxAnt_RANGE;
2225  }
2226  else
2227  {
2228  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_EINTERNAL;
2229  goto exit;
2230  }
2231 
2232  /* Prepare internal hardware resouces = trigger source matchs its paramset index */
2233  rangeProcObj->dataInTrigger[0] = 1U + pConfigIn->hwRes.hwaCfg.paramSetStartIdx;
2234  rangeProcObj->dataInTrigger[1] = 3U + pConfigIn->hwRes.hwaCfg.paramSetStartIdx;
2235  rangeProcObj->dataOutTrigger[0] = 0U + pConfigIn->hwRes.hwaCfg.paramSetStartIdx;
2236  rangeProcObj->dataOutTrigger[1] = 2U + pConfigIn->hwRes.hwaCfg.paramSetStartIdx;
2237 
2238  /* Save hardware resources that will be used at runtime */
2239  rangeProcObj->edmaHandle= pConfigIn->hwRes.edmaHandle;
2240  rangeProcObj->dataOutSignatureChan = (uint8_t)pConfigIn->hwRes.edmaOutCfg.dataOutSignature.tcc;
2241  rangeProcObj->dcRangeSigMean = pConfigIn->hwRes.dcRangeSigMean;
2242  rangeProcObj->dcRangeSigMeanSize = pConfigIn->hwRes.dcRangeSigMeanSize;
2243  (void)memcpy((void *)&rangeProcObj->hwaCfg, (void *)&pConfigIn->hwRes.hwaCfg, sizeof(DPU_RangeProcHWA_HwaConfig));
2244 
2245 exit:
2246  return(retVal);
2247 }

2316 (
2317  DPU_RangeProcHWA_InitParams *initParams,

2320 )
2321 {

2324  uint16_t index;
2325  int32_t status = SystemP_SUCCESS;
2326 
2327  *errCode = 0;

2329  if( (initParams == NULL) ||
2330  (initParams->hwaHandle == NULL) )

2356  }

2358  /* Create semaphore for EDMA done */
2359  status = SemaphoreP_constructBinary(&rangeProcObj->edmaDoneSemaHandle, 0);

2362  *errCode = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_ESEMA;

2364  }
2365 
2366  /* Create semaphore for HWA done */
2367  status = SemaphoreP_constructBinary(&rangeProcObj->hwaDoneSemaHandle, 0);

2369  {
2370  *errCode = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_ESEMA;
2371  goto exit;
2372  }
2373 
2374 exit:
2375  if(*errCode < 0)
2376  {
2377  rangeProcObj = (DPU_RangeProcHWA_Handle)NULL;
2378  }
2379  else
2380  {
2381  /* Fall through */
2382  }
2383  return ((DPU_RangeProcHWA_Handle)rangeProcObj);
2384 
2385 }

2406 int32_t DPU_RangeProcHWA_config
2407 (
2408  DPU_RangeProcHWA_Handle handle,
2409  DPU_RangeProcHWA_Config *pConfigIn
2410 )
2411 {
2412  rangeProcHWAObj *rangeProcObj;
2413  DPU_RangeProcHWA_StaticConfig *pStaticCfg;
2414  HWA_Handle hwaHandle;
2415  int32_t retVal = 0;
2416 
2417  rangeProcObj = (rangeProcHWAObj *)handle;
2418  if(rangeProcObj == NULL)
2419  {
2420  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_EINVAL;
2421  goto exit;
2422  }
2423 
2424  /* Get configuration pointers */
2425  pStaticCfg = &pConfigIn->staticCfg;
2426  hwaHandle = rangeProcObj->initParms.hwaHandle;
2427 
2428 #if DEBUG_CHECK_PARAMS
2429  /* Validate params */
2430  if(!pConfigIn ||
2431  !(pConfigIn->hwRes.edmaHandle) ||
2432  (pConfigIn->hwRes.hwaCfg.numParamSet != DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_NUM_HWA_PARAM_SETS)
2433  )
2434  {
2435  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_EINVAL;
2436  goto exit;
2437  }
2438 
2439  /* Parameter check: validate Adc data interface configuration
2440  Support:
2441  - 1 chirp per chirpEvent
2442  - Complex 16bit ADC data in IMRE format supported for AM273X+2243 Processing Chain
2443  - Real only 16bit ADC data supported for AWR294X Processing Chain
2444  */
2445  if( (pStaticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.dataFmt != DPIF_DATAFORMAT_REAL16) ||
2446  (pStaticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.numChirpsPerChirpEvent != 1U) )
2447  {
2448  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_EADCBUF_INTF;
2449  goto exit;
2450  }
2451 
2452  /* Parameter check: windowing Size */
2453  {
2454  uint16_t expectedWinSize;
2455 
2456  if( pConfigIn->hwRes.hwaCfg.hwaWinSym == HWA_FFT_WINDOW_SYMMETRIC)
2457  {
2458  /* Only half of the windowing factor is needed for symmetric window */
2459  expectedWinSize = ((pStaticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.numAdcSamples + 1U) / 2U ) * (uint16_t)sizeof(uint32_t);
2460  }
2461  else
2462  {
2463  expectedWinSize = pStaticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.numAdcSamples * (uint16_t)sizeof(uint32_t);
2464  }
2465 
2466  if(pStaticCfg->windowSize != expectedWinSize)
2467  {
2468  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_EWINDOW;
2469  goto exit;
2470  }
2471  }
2472 
2473  if(pConfigIn->hwRes.radarCube.data == NULL)
2474  {
2475  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_ERADARCUBE_INTF;
2476  goto exit;
2477  }
2478 
2479 #ifdef SUBSYS_MSS
2480  if(CSL_MEM_IS_NOT_ALIGN(pConfigIn->hwRes.radarCube.data,
2481  DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_RADARCUBE_BYTE_ALIGNMENT_R5F))
2482 #else
2483  if(CSL_MEM_IS_NOT_ALIGN(pConfigIn->hwRes.radarCube.data,
2484  DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_RADARCUBE_BYTE_ALIGNMENT_DSP))
2485 #endif
2486  {
2487  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_ERADARCUBE_INTF;
2488  goto exit;
2489  }
2490 
2491  /* Refer to radar cube definition for FORMAT_x , the following are the only supported formats
2492  Following assumption is made upon radar cube FORMAT_x definition
2493  1. data type is complex in cmplx16ImRe_t format only
2494  2. It is always 1D range output.
2495  */
2496  if( (pConfigIn->hwRes.radarCube.datafmt != DPIF_RADARCUBE_FORMAT_1) &&
2497  (pConfigIn->hwRes.radarCube.datafmt != DPIF_RADARCUBE_FORMAT_2) )
2498  {
2499  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_ERADARCUBE_INTF;
2500  goto exit;
2501  }
2502 
2503  /* Not supported input & output format combination */
2504  if ((pStaticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.interleave == DPIF_RXCHAN_INTERLEAVE_MODE) &&
2505  (pConfigIn->hwRes.radarCube.datafmt == DPIF_RADARCUBE_FORMAT_1) )
2506  {
2507  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_ENOTIMPL;
2508  goto exit;
2509  }
2510  if (pStaticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.numRxAntennas == 3U)
2511  {
2512  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_ENOTIMPL;
2513  goto exit;
2514  }
2515 
2516  /* Parameter check: radarcube buffer Size */
2517  if (pConfigIn->hwRes.radarCube.dataSize != (pStaticCfg->numRangeBins* sizeof(cmplx16ImRe_t) *
2518  pStaticCfg->numChirpsPerFrame *
2519  pStaticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.numRxAntennas) )
2520  {
2521  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_ERADARCUBE_INTF;
2522  goto exit;
2523  }
2524 
2525  /* Parameter check: Num butterfly stages to scale */
2526  if (pStaticCfg->rangeFFTtuning.numLastButterflyStagesToScale > mathUtils_ceilLog2(pStaticCfg->numRangeBins))
2527  {
2528  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_EBUTTERFLYSCALE;
2529  goto exit;
2530  }
2531 #endif
2532 
2533  /* Save hardware resources */
2534  (void)memcpy((void *)&rangeProcObj->calibDcRangeSigCfg,
2535  (void *)pConfigIn->dynCfg.calibDcRangeSigCfg, sizeof(DPU_RangeProc_CalibDcRangeSigCfg));
2536 
2537  retVal = rangeProcHWA_ParseConfig(rangeProcObj, pConfigIn);
2538  if (retVal < 0)
2539  {
2540  goto exit;
2541  }
2542 
2543  /* DC calibration and compensation init */
2544  retVal = rangeProcHWA_dcRangeSignatureCompensation_init(rangeProcObj,
2545  pConfigIn->dynCfg.calibDcRangeSigCfg, pStaticCfg->resetDcRangeSigMeanBuffer);
2546  if (retVal < 0)
2547  {
2548  goto exit;
2549  }
2550 
2551  /* Disable the HWA */
2552  retVal = HWA_enable(hwaHandle, 0);
2553  if (retVal != 0)
2554  {
2555  goto exit;
2556  }
2557 
2558  /* Reset the internal state of the HWA */
2559  retVal = HWA_reset(hwaHandle);
2560  if (retVal != 0)
2561  {
2562  goto exit;
2563  }
2564 
2565  /* Windowing configuraiton in HWA */
2566  retVal = HWA_configRam(hwaHandle,
2567  HWA_RAM_TYPE_WINDOW_RAM,
2568  (uint8_t *)pStaticCfg->window,
2569  pStaticCfg->windowSize, /* size in bytes */
2570  pConfigIn->hwRes.hwaCfg.hwaWinRamOffset * sizeof(uint32_t));
2571  if (retVal != 0)
2572  {
2573  goto exit;
2574  }
2575 
2576  /* Clear stats */
2577  rangeProcObj->numProcess = 0U;
2578 
2579  /* Initial configuration of rangeProc */
2580  retVal = rangeProcHWA_HardwareConfig(rangeProcObj, &pConfigIn->hwRes);
2581 
2582 exit:
2583  return retVal;
2584 }

2604 int32_t DPU_RangeProcHWA_process
2605 (
2606  DPU_RangeProcHWA_Handle handle,
2607  DPU_RangeProcHWA_OutParams *outParams
2608 )
2609 {
2610  rangeProcHWAObj *rangeProcObj;
2611  int32_t retVal = 0;
2612 
2613  rangeProcObj = (rangeProcHWAObj *)handle;
2614  if ((rangeProcObj == NULL) ||
2615  (outParams == NULL))
2616  {
2617  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_EINVAL;
2618  goto exit;
2619  }
2620 
2621  /* Set inProgress state */
2622  rangeProcObj->inProgress = true;
2623  outParams->endOfChirp = false;
2624 
2625  /**********************************************/
2626  /* WAIT FOR HWA NUMLOOPS INTERRUPT */
2627  /**********************************************/
2628  /* wait for the all paramSets done interrupt */
2629  (void)SemaphoreP_pend(&rangeProcObj->hwaDoneSemaHandle, SystemP_WAIT_FOREVER);
2630 
2631  /**********************************************/
2632  /* WAIT FOR EDMA INTERRUPT */
2633  /**********************************************/
2634  (void)SemaphoreP_pend(&rangeProcObj->edmaDoneSemaHandle, SystemP_WAIT_FOREVER);
2635 
2636  /* Range FFT is done, disable Done interrupt */
2637  (void)HWA_disableDoneInterrupt(rangeProcObj->initParms.hwaHandle, 0);
2638 
2639  /* Disable the HWA */
2640  retVal = HWA_enable(rangeProcObj->initParms.hwaHandle, 0);
2641  if (retVal != 0)
2642  {
2643  goto exit;
2644  }
2645 
2646  /* calib DC processing if enabled */
2647  if(rangeProcObj->calibDcRangeSigCfg.enabled != 0U)
2648  {
2649  rangeProcHWA_dcRangeSignatureCompensation(rangeProcObj);
2650  }
2651  /* Update stats and output parameters */
2652  rangeProcObj->numProcess++;
2653 
2654  /* Following stats is not available for rangeProcHWA */
2655  outParams->stats.processingTime = 0;
2656  outParams->stats.waitTime= 0;
2657 
2658  outParams->endOfChirp = true;
2659 
2660  /* Clear inProgress state */
2661  rangeProcObj->inProgress = false;
2662 
2663 exit:
2664 
2665  return retVal;
2666 }

2688 int32_t DPU_RangeProcHWA_control
2689 (
2690  DPU_RangeProcHWA_Handle handle,
2691  DPU_RangeProcHWA_Cmd cmd,
2692  void* arg,
2693  uint32_t argSize
2694 )
2695 {
2696  int32_t retVal = 0;
2697  rangeProcHWAObj *rangeProcObj;
2698 
2699  /* Get rangeProc data object */
2700  rangeProcObj = (rangeProcHWAObj *)handle;
2701 
2702  /* Sanity check */
2703  if (rangeProcObj == NULL)
2704  {
2705  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_EINVAL;
2706  goto exit;
2707  }
2708 
2709  /* Check if control() is called during processing time */
2710  if(rangeProcObj->inProgress == true)
2711  {
2712  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_EINPROGRESS;
2713  goto exit;
2714  }
2715 
2716  /* Control command handling */
2717  switch(cmd)
2718  {
2719  case DPU_RangeProcHWA_Cmd_dcRangeCfg:
2720  {
2721  DPU_RangeProc_CalibDcRangeSigCfg *calibDc;
2722 
2723  if((argSize != sizeof(DPU_RangeProc_CalibDcRangeSigCfg)) ||
2724  (arg == NULL))
2725  {
2726  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_EDCREMOVAL;
2727  goto exit;
2728  }
2729  else
2730  {
2731  calibDc = (DPU_RangeProc_CalibDcRangeSigCfg *)arg;
2732 
2733  if(memcmp((void *)&rangeProcObj->calibDcRangeSigCfg,
2734  (void *)calibDc, sizeof(DPU_RangeProc_CalibDcRangeSigCfg)) == 0)
2735  {
2736  /* NO configuration change, nothing needs to be done here */
2737  }
2738  else
2739  {
2740  /* If dcRangeSignature configuration is changed , always reset buffer and counter */
2741  retVal = rangeProcHWA_dcRangeSignatureCompensation_init(rangeProcObj, calibDc, 1U);
2742  if(retVal < 0)
2743  {
2744  goto exit;
2745  }
2746  else
2747  {
2748  /* Save configuration */
2749  (void)memcpy((void *)&rangeProcObj->calibDcRangeSigCfg, (void *)arg, argSize);
2750  }
2751  }
2752  }
2753  }
2754  break;
2755 
2756  case DPU_RangeProcHWA_Cmd_triggerProc:
2757  /* Trigger rangeProc in HWA */
2758  retVal = rangeProcHWA_TriggerHWA( rangeProcObj);
2759  if(retVal != 0)
2760  {
2761  goto exit;
2762  }
2763  break;
2764 
2765  default:
2766  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_ECMD;
2767  break;
2768  }
2769 exit:
2770  return (retVal);
2771 }
2772

2791 (
2792  DPU_RangeProcHWA_Handle handle
2793 )

2795  rangeProcHWAObj *rangeProcObj;
2796  int32_t retVal = 0;
2797 
2798  /* Sanity Check */
2799  rangeProcObj = (rangeProcHWAObj *)handle;
2800  if(rangeProcObj == NULL)
2801  {
2802  retVal = DPU_RANGEPROCHWA_EINVAL;
2803  goto exit;
2804  }
2805 
2806  /* Delete Semaphores */
2807  SemaphoreP_destruct(&rangeProcObj->edmaDoneSemaHandle);

2809 
2810 exit:
2811 
2812  return (retVal);
2813 }
